items.title: Texas Democrats pull off the breakthrough they’ve chased for decades, reshaping national politics
items.brief: For decades, Texas Democrats have dreamt of turning the state blue, rallying around exciting candidates who drew big crowds and big money but could not ultimately overcome the state’s stubborn conservative majority.

items.title: What Trump’s midterms setback could mean for Iran, Israel and Ukraine
items.brief: The US midterm elections could have consequences far beyond the country’s borders.

items.title: CVS to split into two companies, in major breakup of its $117 billion healthcare empire
items.brief: CVS Health said Wednesday it is splitting into two companies, marking one of the largest shakeups in the healthcare industry.

items.title: Dow jumps by 1,200 points as Democrats take control of Congress
items.brief: US stocks soared Wednesday as Wall Street digested the resounding Democrat sweep in the midterm elections and mulled what a divided government will mean for President Donald Trump’s policy agenda as well as the AI trade.

items.title: Do you use AI agents to run your daily life? We want to hear about it
items.brief: Tech giants are betting that AI agents will play a key role in how people get things done in the future – from shopping for groceries to returning packages and planning vacations.

items.title: Former federal prosecutor to lead Cornell sex assault investigation
items.brief: The New York attorney general’s office tapped a former federal prosecutor experienced in sex crime cases to lead the criminal investigation into allegations of sexual assault at Cornell University .

items.title: Spanish soccer player Jesús de Miguel dies after on-pitch collision
items.brief: Soccer player Jesús de Miguel has died after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match on Monday, his club CD Tenerife has said.

items.title: Melania Trump to bring Russian and Ukrainian representatives to White House this week
items.brief: First lady Melania Trump will bring representatives from Russia and Ukraine to the White House on Thursday, after announcing a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky last month.
